name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began in his grandfather's Belgrade workshop, where he spent countless hours dismantling and rebuilding old Lada engines. This hands-on experience ignited a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in composite materials. After graduating, Nikola honed his skills at a local racing team, fabricating chassis components for rally cars. He quickly earned a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues under pressure.

At Hendrick Motorsports, Nikola thrives on the challenge of pushing the boundaries of automotive engineering. He approaches every fabrication project with a blend of precision and creativity, constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve performance and durability. His dedication to quality and his collaborative spirit make him a valuable asset to the team, contributing significantly to the team's success on the track. His ambition is to one day lead a fabrication team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his tools after each use, regardless of how busy he is.
Can often be found humming quietly to himself while working on intricate fabrication tasks.
